audit_items.proof_trace: The monotonicity invariant is enforced by two independent guards: (1) `borrow_index::set_value` explicitly asserts `self.value.le(value)` (new >= old) and `self.last_updated <= now` before every write; (2) `reserve::accrue_interest` computes `new_index = prior * (1 + interest_rate * delta_t)` where `interest_rate` is an unsigned Decimal and `delta_t` is u64 (Move aborts on underflow if `now < last_updated`), guaranteeing the new index is always >= the prior. All entry points derive `now` from Sui's trusted `Clock` object (`clock::timestamp_ms(clock) / 1000`), not from user input.
